# powerhmc_lpar (Data Source)

Retrieves information about a Logical Partition (LPAR).

Use this data source to look up an existing LPAR and read its processor, memory, networking, storage, and Fibre Channel configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up an existing LPAR by managed system and partition name.
data "powerhmc_lpar" "my_lpar" {
  system_name = "my-managed-system"
  lpar_name   = "lpar1"
}

output "lpar_uuid" {
  value = data.powerhmc_lpar.my_lpar.lpar_uuid
}

output "lpar_state" {
  value = data.powerhmc_lpar.my_lpar.state
}

output "lpar_processor_mode" {
  value = data.powerhmc_lpar.my_lpar.proc_config.proc_mode
}

output "lpar_virtual_networks" {
  value = data.powerhmc_lpar.my_lpar.virtual_networks
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `lpar_name` (String) Name of the LPAR partition.
- `system_name` (String) Name of the managed system where the LPAR resides.

### Read-Only

- `io_slots` (List of String) List of physical I/O slot locations assigned to the LPAR.
- `ip_address` (String) IP address of the LPAR for resource monitoring (RMC). This field may be empty if RMC is not active or IP address is not available.
- `lpar_uuid` (String) UUID of the LPAR partition.
- `mem_config` (Attributes) Memory configuration for the LPAR partition. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--mem_config))
- `os_version` (String) Operating system version running on the LPAR.
- `partition_type` (String) Partition type (e.g., `AIX/Linux`, `ibmi`).
- `physical_volumes` (Attributes List) List of physical volumes mapped to this LPAR via VIOS SCSI mappings. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--physical_volumes))
- `proc_config` (Attributes) Processor configuration for the LPAR partition. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--proc_config))
- `profile_name` (String) Name of the partition profile.
- `reference_code` (String) Reference code associated with the LPAR partition.
- `rmc_state` (String) Current RMC (Resource Monitoring and Control) state of the LPAR partition.
- `state` (String) Current state of the LPAR partition (e.g., `running`, `not activated`).
- `virtual_fibre_channels` (Attributes List) List of virtual Fibre Channel mappings for this LPAR (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--virtual_fibre_channels))
- `virtual_networks` (Attributes List) List of virtual networks attached to the LPAR via client network adapters. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--virtual_networks))

<a id="nestedatt--mem_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `mem_config`

Read-Only:

- `current_mem` (Number) Current memory in MB.
- `desired` (Number) Desired memory in MB.
- `max` (Number) Maximum memory in MB.
- `min` (Number) Minimum memory in MB.


<a id="nestedatt--physical_volumes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `physical_volumes`

Read-Only:

- `phy_volume_names` (List of String) List of physical volume names exposed via SCSI mappings from this VIOS.
- `vios_name` (String) Name of the VIOS that owns these SCSI mappings.


<a id="nestedatt--proc_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `proc_config`

Read-Only:

- `current_proc` (Number) Current number of dedicated processors.
- `current_proc_units` (String) Current processing units.
- `current_uncapped_weight` (Number) Current uncapped weight value allocated to the partition.
- `current_virtual_proc` (Number) Current number of virtual processors.
- `desired_proc` (Number) Desired number of dedicated processors (for dedicated mode).
- `desired_proc_units` (String) Desired processing units (for shared mode).
- `desired_virtual_proc` (Number) Desired number of virtual processors (for shared mode).
- `max_proc` (Number) Maximum number of dedicated processors (for dedicated mode).
- `max_proc_units` (String) Maximum processing units (for shared mode).
- `max_virtual_proc` (Number) Maximum number of virtual processors (for shared mode).
- `min_proc` (Number) Minimum number of dedicated processors (for dedicated mode).
- `min_proc_units` (String) Minimum processing units (for shared mode).
- `min_virtual_proc` (Number) Minimum number of virtual processors (for shared mode).
- `proc_mode` (String) Processor sharing mode (e.g., `cap`, `uncap`, `keep_idle_procs`).
- `shared_proc_pool_id` (Number) Shared processor pool ID (for shared mode).
- `uncapped_weight` (Number) Uncapped weight for the partition (for uncapped shared mode).


<a id="nestedatt--virtual_fibre_channels"></a>
### Nested Schema for `virtual_fibre_channels`

Read-Only:

- `port_name` (String) Physical FC port name on the VIOS (e.g., `fcs0`, `fcs2`).
- `slot_number` (Number) Virtual slot number on the LPAR for this Fibre Channel adapter.
- `vios_name` (String) Name of the VIOS that owns this FC mapping.


<a id="nestedatt--virtual_networks"></a>
### Nested Schema for `virtual_networks`

Read-Only:

- `network_adapter` (Map of String) Map of network adapter location code to MAC address. Format: `{"location_code": "MAC_address"}`. MAC addresses are formatted with colons (e.g., `4A:79:55:27:8C:02`).
- `network_name` (String) Name of the virtual network.
- `slot_number` (Number) Virtual slot number of the client network adapter.
